subject: Your hosting report for October 2026: one quick thing
preview: Your website is healthy. One quick thing inside.
headline: Your website is healthy.
headlineSentence: It was up 99.98% of October, it loaded fast, and it was backed up every night.
opener: I hope this email finds you well!
careLog: This month I watched your site around the clock, applied two security updates, renewed your security certificate, and checked every nightly backup (I even test-restored one to make sure it works).

attention.title: Your domain renews Dec 7
attention.body: Northwind IT manages it, so it's worth a quick check that it's set to auto-renew. Want me to check with them for you? Just reply and I'll take care of it.

highlights.title: Always on
highlights.caption: Your site was up all month except for 9 minutes on Oct 14.
highlights.alt: Bar chart of how often the site was up each month, May to October. October 99.98%, September 99.97%.

highlights.title: Fast on phones
highlights.caption: Pages start loading in under half a second. Google scores your site 94 out of 100 for speed on phones, up from 92.
highlights.alt: Bar chart of Google's mobile speed score out of 100 each month. October 94, September 92.

highlights.title: No error pages
highlights.caption: Visitors didn't run into a single error page this month, down from two in September.
highlights.alt: Bar chart of error pages visitors hit each month. October 0, September 2.

checklist.label: Backups
checklist.line: Every night, 31 of 31. Test restore worked on Oct 3.

checklist.label: Server
checklist.line: Up to date with this month's security updates.

checklist.label: Billing
checklist.line: October's $35 payment went through Oct 1. Thanks!

close.question: Questions about your site or ideas for it? Just reply, it comes straight to me.
close.projectLine: Want something changed or added to your site? I take on projects too.
close.projectLinkText: Tell me what you have in mind
close.thanks: Thanks for letting me take care of it!
